run_lsp_hover: run lsp_hover on a TypeScript file at a given line and character to get symbol documentation
run_lsp_definition: run lsp_definition on a TypeScript file at a given line and character to find symbol definition locations
run_lsp_references: run lsp_references on a TypeScript file at a given line and character to find all symbol references
run_lsp_document_symbols: run lsp_document_symbols on a TypeScript file to list all document-level symbols
run_lsp_workspace_symbols: run lsp_workspace_symbols with a query string to search for symbols across the workspace
